name: Terminal
author: Brett
description: Windows-style terminal: a Windows Terminal window with its own tab strip (rename, colour, drag to reorder, duplicate, move to a new window), a command toolbar and Windows keys. Claude Code tabs open on any connection (console container, VPS root, any container, axHub) through a connection picker; right-click a tab for its Connection manager. Claude Code profiles (model, permissions, flags, folder, first prompt, colour, default connection). Live settings: colour schemes, font, cursor, line height, padding, bell, scrollback, startup, tab width. Mouse mode, Mosh mode, copy/paste, phone key row, idle timeout and a session log. Settings → Plugins → Terminal.
